comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This color-customizable outfit can be produced at Florence (accessed via Pisa's carriage) in Lorenzo's office after you unlock the Trendsetter or Cultural Contributor titles -- speak to Lorenzo for a short scene, then it will become available to produce at Roberta, the sewing maid.

Note you will need Cultural Contributor title active to equip/layer it. Cheers.
